title: Njàngalem Boroom bi
intro: Danga fekk sa bopp ci réew mu bari ay yéeme yu yàgg ak feeñu yu xóot. Benn njiit bu am doole, bimu jànkoonte ak invite bumu xamul woon, mu dem tukki bu nara soppi ëlëgam ak ngëmu askanam. Ndax mën nga wane nit ku mag kii?
clues: Maa ngi jiitewoon réew mu am xaalis, bari alal ak jal bu rafet.
Man ak sama askan danu daan jaamu mbindéef bu nekk ci asamaan si, gëm ni mooy sunu boroom, doonte daa am sikki-sakka ci sama xol.
Benn ndaw bu amul fenn, di picc, yónnee ma bataaxal, di woo man ak sama askan ñu déggal benn Yàlla.
Ma laaj samay xalaatkat, ñoom ñépp am doole, ñu xam naka lañu wara toppatoo bataaxal bu musul am bii.
Ma jël dogal ni damay yónnee ki ma yónnee bataaxal bi kado bu am solo, ndax dinaa xam dooleem ak mébetam.
Bima yegsee, ma yéemu ci palaas bu am dër bu ñu defaree weer, mu nuru benn lëmu ndox, ci noonu ma wax ni damay topp Boroom biy sàkk lépp.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
